verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official CLI, zepctl, for administering Zep projects. It claims full access to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal, and a probe confirms the official CLI documentation page exists. missing for 10: details of commands, auth and installation in the evidence, AI-native/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: zepctl is a command-line interface for administering Zep projects. It provides full access to Zep, enabling you to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal.
